carriers.link: closed curves in space that do not touch
carriers.closed surface: a surface with no edge, such as a sphere or a torus
carriers.surface with edge: a surface with a boundary, such as a disc or a tube
carriers.3-manifold: a space that looks like ordinary space near every point
carriers.cell complex: points, edges, faces and higher cells glued along their boundaries
carriers.planar tiling: a division of a surface into polygons
carriers.rooted binary tree: a tree that splits in two at every branch point
carriers.cyclic word: a ring of letters, counted up to rotation
carriers.tangent field: an arrow at every point of a surface
carriers.line field: a direction without an arrowhead at every point of a surface
carriers.random field: a function on a space, chosen at random
carriers.orbit: the path of a body under gravity
carriers.differential equation: a rule for how a quantity changes
carriers.record store: a set of records with fields

invariants.linking number: how many times one closed curve winds through another
invariants.Milnor number: detects three or more curves that hold together with no two linked
invariants.Euler characteristic: points minus edges plus faces, and so on with alternating signs
invariants.Betti numbers: the number of pieces, loops and enclosed holes
invariants.index sum: the total strength of the points where a field stops or is undefined
invariants.genus: the number of handles of a surface
invariants.count: how many structures of each size there are (an integer sequence)
invariants.distribution on shapes: the probability of each shape under a growth rule
invariants.critical elements: the parts whose removal makes the whole come apart
invariants.entropy bound: the largest possible number of configurations
invariants.energy sign: whether a body is bound or escapes

moves.Reidemeister move: one of three local changes of a link diagram that do not change the link
moves.edge flip: replace the shared edge of two triangles by the other diagonal
moves.vertex split: replace one triangle by three, or the reverse
moves.tip growth: a new branch forms at a tip
moves.segment growth: a new branch forms anywhere along the tree
moves.suspension: pinch both ends of a tube to points
moves.contraction: shrink a part to a point
moves.scaling: multiply every length by the same factor

infinity_handled_by.formula: a closed formula or recurrence valid for every n, confirmed by a finite independent count
infinity_handled_by.moves: finitely many kinds of local move reach every case, and the claim survives each move
infinity_handled_by.limit: a limit object or a compactness theorem
infinity_handled_by.edge: a physical cutoff: the family does not continue past it
infinity_handled_by.impossible: provably cannot be reduced to a finite check

arrow_kinds.part_of: things at this level are parts of things at the target level
arrow_kinds.coarse_grains_to: the target forgets detail: many of these become one of those
arrow_kinds.limit_of: the target is what this becomes as n goes to infinity
arrow_kinds.dual_of: the same structure with points and faces exchanged
arrow_kinds.same_invariant: both levels compute the same invariant on the same kind of object
arrow_kinds.same_move: both levels change by the same local move
arrow_kinds.same_carrier: both levels study the same kind of object
